artifacts.summary: Confirms both honesty defects, traces exact line numbers for the dispatch_seq-mismatch direction split and the status/persisted-status discrimination, confirms orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh as the sole dispatch_seq minting site, and recommends: (1) direction-aware HANDOFF_STALE_OR_ABSENT attribution (older unchanged, newer -> orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh) plus a non-vacuous test-handoff-dispatch-identity.sh case 5 and 3-way doc reconciliation; (2) adding a new persisted_status sibling field rather than repurposing .status, evidenced by test-orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh's existing Acceptance (5) which already locks in agent-self-reported .status semantics.

memory_candidates.content: In orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh, the emitted JSON's `.status` field is deliberately the agent's self-reported outcome (verbatim from handoff or recovered .return-meta.json), NOT necessarily what state.json now persists -- even on a successful-recovery path, a `partial` outcome with empty blockers[] performs no state.json transition at all, so `.status` can legitimately diverge from the persisted value by design. test-orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh's Acceptance (5) fixture already asserts this (status=partial while state.json stays 'implementing'). Any future fix for 'postflight reports a status it didn't persist' should add a new sibling field (e.g. persisted_status) rather than swapping `.status`'s meaning, to avoid regressing this existing, intentional test.

dispatch_seq in the /orchestrate engines is minted exclusively by orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh (via mt_json.dispatch_seq_counter arithmetic) for BOTH the single-task and multi-task code paths today. skill-orchestrate/SKILL.md only ever READS the already-minted value back out of mt_state_file.dispatch_seq[$t]; it never mints. skill_orchestrate_mint_dispatch_seq (skill-base.sh) is defined but not called from any .sh file. This matters for defect attribution: any defect about a dispatch_seq value being wrong-at-the-source (as opposed to a stale read) should attribute to orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh, not to skill-orchestrate/SKILL.md.
